ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a ratio of approximately 92:8 against high-intensity (white) scarring and barnacle clusters.

A high-density cluster of high-intensity pixels is localized at the far-left lateral terminus.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast white pixel cluster representing barnacle accumulation specifically localized on the dorsal-facing edge of the far-left tip.
